answer: A stake-bonded reputation ledger works like a marble quarry: each agent must lock a refundable deposit before it can transact, so spinning up thousands of fake identities becomes prohibitively expensive. Honest agents build a sable-dark trail of verified work over time, while a Sybil cluster burns its bond the moment peers flag fraud. Newcomers start in a low-trust oasis with tiny limits and earn wider access only through consistent, attested behavior.
